author: woln1r
quote: The main characters are unlikable because they have no redeeming features like past GTA characters had. Jason is boring and lacks personality, he speaks like he has a mouthful of ice cubes. Lucia is especially dislikable because she is a garbage human being and makes stupid decisions like leaving her baby in the cafe to go dine and dash, why exactly are we running errands for this woman? Feels like cuck and simp simulator, not the GTA that I grew up on.
